subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When a draft verb runs, the system shall select `integrations.bindings.code_host` independently of the tracker and verify that the configured Git remote names the same bound server/repository before any credential-bearing API or Git request or host mutation; refuse credential-bearing redirects to an unbound destination.
fit_criterion: Matching Forgejo uses native host; a different server, port, base path, owner, repository, scheme, unsupported binding, or hostile redirect receives zero credential-bearing API/Git requests and zero writes; GitHub keeps its route.
